## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling lives in `style.css`. The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- JavaScript must never write inline styles (`element.style.*`). JS may only toggle classes, `data-*` attributes, and ARIA state. Heat map cell colors MUST come from pre-declared CSS attribute selectors (Section 3), never from JS-computed inline styles.
- Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class or ID selectors only.
- Keep HTML semantic and style-agnostic: retheming the page must require editing `style.css` only, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define all tokens in `:root` and override per theme:
- **Colors:** `--primary: #0080FF`, `--secondary: #FF0000`, `--bg-primary`, `--bg-secondary`, `--text-primary`, `--text-secondary`, `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default`, `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
- **Light mode (default):** `--bg-primary: #F4F7FA` (cool off-white — never `#ffffff`; use `#FEFEFE` wherever a near-white is required, including `--bg-secondary` and the heat scale midpoint), `--text-primary: #10202E`, `--text-secondary: #51637A`, `--border-default: #D8E1EA`, `--text-success: #0E8345`, `--text-error: #C81E1E`.
- **Heat scale tokens:** `--heat-cool: #0080FF`, `--heat-mid: #FEFEFE`, `--heat-hot: #FF0000`; `--heat-gradient: linear-gradient(90deg, #0080FF 0%, #FEFEFE 50%, #FF0000 100%)` (divergent, blue→white→red); `--heat-gradient-sequential: linear-gradient(90deg, #FEFEFE 0%, #FFD34D 50%, #FF0000 100%)` (thermal scale for unsigned magnitude, used by the geographic map); `--heat-gradient-mono` (monochromatic shades of `--primary`).
- **Shape & motion:** `--radius-sm`, `--radius-md`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--spacing-gap`, `--transition-fast` (hover feedback), `--transition-normal` (state changes), `--ease-standard`.
- **Stacking:** `--z-dropdown` (cell tooltips, mobile nav panel), `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.
- **Contrast pairing:** every light background token must pair with a dark text token and every dark background token with a light text token — enforced in both themes, including any text placed on heat-colored surfaces (see 3.2).

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode**
- Provide dark tokens under BOTH `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class on `<html>`. Suggested: `--bg-primary: #0B1421`, `--bg-secondary: #121E30`, `--text-primary: #E7EEF6`, `--text-secondary: #93A4B8`, adjusted borders.
- **Dark-mode heat scale adjustments:** `--heat-mid` shifts to a neutral `#2E3E55` (a white midpoint would glare on dark surfaces), `--heat-cool` brightens to `#3D9BFF`, `--heat-hot` to `#FF4D42` for contrast.
- Theme switching must swap variables only — no HTML restructuring.
- Header toggle: Google Material Symbols `dark_mode`/`light_mode` (render both, hide per theme via CSS), `aria-pressed`, `aria-label="Toggle dark mode"`. Persist choice in `localStorage` (key `heatlens-theme`); fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit (first paint therefore needs no JS and cannot flash); apply any stored choice at the top of `script.js`.

**1.4 Layout: Flexbox + CSS Grid, Mobile-First**
- Build component and section layouts with Flexbox. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is justified in a code comment (permitted exceptions: equal-height card rows may `stretch`; stacked form groups may `flex-start`).
- Reserve CSS Grid (`display: grid`) for the heat map matrix, its axis labels, and the legend tick row.
- Mobile-first: multi-column layouts collapse to a single column below 768px; zero horizontal scrolling at any width ≥320px.

**1.5 Framework: Tailwind CSS**
- Use Tailwind CSS (the Play CDN build is acceptable; its external `<script src>` tag is the only permitted script besides your own). Compose reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, …) via `@layer components` / `@apply`, and map every color/spacing utility back to the CSS variables in 1.2 — no hardcoded hex values inside utilities.

**1.6 Typography & Icons — Google Fonts Mandatory**
- Google Fonts via `<link>`: **Space Grotesk** (headings, `--font-display`), **Inter** (body, `--font-base`), **IBM Plex Mono** (all numeric data, axis labels, legend values, prices, metrics, `--font-mono`).
- Icons: Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the official `<link>` — e.g. `grid_on`, `map`, `palette`, `storage`, `tune`, `insights`, `check_circle`, `close`, `menu`, `dark_mode`, `light_mode`, `progress_activity`, `bolt`.
- Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden for UI iconography. **Explicit exception:** inline SVG is permitted exclusively as the data surface of the geographic heat map in Feature card 2 (Section 4.2) — nothing else.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Buttons** — all states class-driven:
- Base `.btn`: `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px. Variants: `.btn--primary` (solid `--primary`, white label), `.btn--secondary` (outlined), `.btn--ghost`, `.btn--danger` (visually distinct in both themes).
- Hover: brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer` (`--transition-fast`). Focus-visible: distinct ring via `box-shadow` using `--primary`. Active: `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- `.is-loading`: spinner = Material `progress_activity` icon rotated by a CSS keyframe; button keeps exact dimensions, sets `aria-busy="true"`, and blocks pointer events to prevent double-clicks.
- `[disabled]`: `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- `.is-success` / `.is-error`: transient feedback styles driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.

**2.2 Cards** — `.card` base: `--bg-secondary` surface, `--border-default`, `--radius-lg`, `--shadow-sm`, flexible flexbox interior.
- Hover: `--shadow-md` + `transform: translateY(-2px)`. Focus-within: border highlight when a child link/button receives focus.
- Define a CSS-only `.skeleton` shimmer animation (prevents layout jumps) and use it for the demo modal's loading state (2.4).
- Define a `.card--empty` fallback pattern (Material icon + one-line guidance text) available for any async content that fails to initialize.

**2.3 Forms & Inputs** — Final CTA email capture (4.7):
- Structure: flex `.input-group` wrapping `<label>`, `<input type="email">`, and a dedicated `.input-group__error` container.
- States, all class-driven: empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (`.is-valid`: `--border-success` + `check_circle` icon), invalid (`.is-invalid`: `--border-error`, red helper text, `error` icon, `aria-invalid="true"`, error message linked via `aria-describedby`), disabled, read-only.
- Validate on submit and blur; announce errors via an `aria-live="polite"` region; on success the submit button runs loading → success and fires a toast (2.5).

**2.4 Modal / Popup** — "Watch demo" modal triggered from the Hero:
- Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), dimmed backdrop, `--z-modal`, animated opening/closing via CSS transitions (opacity + scale).
- Contents: title, a demo preview area (a CSS-animated mini heat map or illustrated placeholder — no external video), close button (Material `close`, `aria-label="Close dialog"`).
- States: opening → open → loading (skeleton shimmer) → success/error message area → closing.
- UX: `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`, keyboard focus trap, `Esc` closes, backdrop click closes, focus returns to the trigger on close.

**2.5 Tooltip / Cell Popover & Toast**
- Heat map tooltip: triggered by click / Enter / Space on cells; absolutely positioned, `--z-dropdown`; shows metric name, exact value, and delta vs baseline in `--font-mono`. Dismiss via `Esc` and outside click. JS positions it only by toggling flip/shift classes (`.tooltip--flip`, `.tooltip--shift`) — never inline styles. Tooltip content is announced via `aria-live`.
- Toast: bottom-center (mobile) / bottom-right (desktop) component at `--z-toast`, `role="status"`, auto-dismiss ~4s with a CSS transition; used for form success and heat map data-refresh confirmations.

## 3. HEAT MAP VISUALIZATION SPECIFICATIONS (theme core)

**3.1 Hero Matrix Heat Map**
- Build a "weekly activity" matrix with CSS Grid: 7 rows (Mon–Sun) × 12 columns (2-hour blocks), with text axis labels in `--font-mono` (days left, hours bottom).
- Every cell is a `<button class="heat-cell" data-intensity="N">` with a descriptive `aria-label` (e.g., "Tuesday 14:00–16:00, +64% vs baseline"). Initial `data-intensity` values (0–10) must be present in the HTML so the map fully renders without JS.
- Color mapping lives ONLY in CSS: define 11 attribute selectors `.heat-cell[data-intensity="0"]` … `[data-intensity="10"]` interpolating the divergent scale — 0 = deepest cool blue (`#0080FF`), 5 = neutral (`--heat-mid`), 10 = hottest red (`#FF0000`). Values below baseline map to the cool half; above baseline to the hot half.
- Smooth color animation: `transition: background-color var(--transition-normal) var(--ease-standard)` on every cell.

**3.2 Intensity Legend & Accessible Alternatives**
- Legend bar directly under the matrix: `background: var(--heat-gradient)` with min/mid/max tick labels in mono font ("−100% · Below baseline", "0 · Baseline", "+100% · Above baseline").
- A "Colorblind-friendly mode" switch (`aria-pressed`) toggles `.heat-grid--accessible`: cells then display their signed numeric value in mono font, with CSS-defined text colors per intensity range (dark text on light/mid cells, white text on saturated cells) so no state is ever conveyed by hue alone.

**3.3 Interactions**
- Hover: cell highlight (outline + brightness/scale), `cursor: pointer`.
- Click / Enter / Space: tooltip reveal (2.5).
- "Simulate live data" button (Material `bolt`): loading state (~800ms) → JS reassigns `data-intensity` values in a column-staggered wave so colors cascade; announce "Heat map updated" via `aria-live`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, apply values instantly with no stagger.

**3.4 Geographic Heat Map (Feature card 2 visual)**
- Compact inline-SVG region/world map (the only permitted SVG, per 1.6). Regions are shaded with the same `data-intensity` attribute scale but mapped to the sequential thermal gradient (`--heat-gradient-sequential`: neutral → yellow → red), since magnitude is unsigned.
- Hover highlights a region; click reveals the tooltip with region name + value. The SVG carries `role="img"` with an `aria-label` summary and is followed by a visually hidden `<table>` listing each region's value for screen readers.

**3.5 Canvas Scope Clause**
- The "canvas for large datasets" technique applies to the real product, not this page: all demo heat maps in this landing page must be DOM/CSS Grid based to guarantee keyboard and screen-reader accessibility. Do not use `<canvas>` in this deliverable.

## 5. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid type via `clamp()`; no horizontal overflow at any width ≥320px; all rows collapse to columns on mobile.
- **Smooth animations:** every state change transitions with `var(--transition-normal)` (hover feedback with `--transition-fast`); fully respect `prefers-reduced-motion` — disable transforms, waves, and shimmer, keeping instant state changes.
- **Accessibility:** WCAG AA contrast in both themes; semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `footer`); skip-to-content link; correct ARIA roles/labels on all custom widgets (theme toggle, accordion, tooltip, modal, segmented control); logical DOM/focus order; complete keyboard operability — no mouse-only interactions; `aria-live` regions for form errors, toasts, and data refresh; never communicate state by color alone (heat values are always available as text via tooltips, labels, or accessible mode).
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** any reset/clear control (e.g., a "Reset demo" action near the simulator) must use `.btn--danger` and remain visually distinct in both themes.
- Anchor links must smooth-scroll and move focus to the target section.

- **Files:** `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js` — separate, complete, and runnable. The only permitted `<script>` tags are the Tailwind CDN (external `src` only) and one deferred `<script src="script.js">`. No inline script blocks, no `style` attributes, no inline event handlers.

- **No external images:** build all visuals from CSS gradients, the one permitted SVG map, and Material Symbols, so the page renders with only the Google Fonts/Icons and Tailwind CDNs.
- Output all three files in full, complete and functional on the first attempt.
